scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: Faces tell stories! Happy face, sleepy face, hungry face… Tomás has a hungry face right now.
scene.intro: Faces tell stories. Freya is happy today, because it is Friday. Tomás is hungry — he is always hungry — and his stomach makes noises in class. Nico is tired, Astrid is a little angry because her pencil is broken, and Pip is thirsty. Are you happy? Are you sad? I am fine, thank you! How do YOU feel today? Show your face and tell us!

data.voice_note: Voces: Freya y Tomás (jugando a las caras).
data.script: Freya: Faces game! Look at my face. How do I feel? … Tomas: You are happy! Big smile! … Freya: Now you. Oh no… you are hungry, Tomás! … Tomas: Yes! It's almost lunch time! … Freya: Nico is tired today. He played football all morning. … Tomas: And Astrid is happy — she has a new book. … Freya: And Pip? … Tomas: Pip is sleepy. Look, his eyes are closing… goodnight, Pip!

outcomes.puede: Understand short simple dialogues about family, school, animals, food (Cambridge Starters Listening parts 1–4).
Answer picture-prompted questions; describe a picture in simple sentences.
Read 2–3-sentence texts; match pictures to words and short captions.
Copy words and complete short sentences (Starters Reading/Writing parts).
~450 words (Starters wordlist); Present simple, present continuous (limited), there is/are, like + -ing.
